Free PDF tools in your browser

Merge, split, edit and convert PDF files in your browser. Free local OCR, English–Hindi translation, writing tools and resume feedback. No account required.

Select a tool below. JavaScript is needed to process documents.

  • Merge PDF — Bring your files together.
  • Split PDF — Keep just the pages you need.
  • Compress PDF — Less size. Same story.
  • Edit PDF — Edit text, erase characters, add more.
  • PDF to Word — From PDF to editable text.
  • Word to PDF — Give your words a new format.
  • PDF to JPG — Every page, an image.
  • JPG to PDF — Pictures, meet pages.
  • PDF to PowerPoint — Put your pages on slides.
  • PowerPoint to PDF — Turn slide text into pages.
  • PDF to Excel — Take your text to a spreadsheet.
  • Excel to PDF — Turn spreadsheets into pages.
  • Organize PDF — Reorder. Rotate. Remove.
  • Remove pages — Leave out what you don’t need.
  • Extract pages — Pull out the important parts.
  • Rotate PDF — Get a fresh perspective.
  • Sign PDF — Add your personal signature.
  • Watermark — Make it yours.
  • Page numbers — Keep every page in order.
  • Crop PDF — Focus on what matters.
  • HTML to PDF — From markup to document.
  • PDF to Markdown — Take your text anywhere.
  • OCR PDF — Make scanned text searchable.
  • Compare PDFs — See what changed.
  • Redact PDF — Remove sensitive areas.
  • PDF Forms — Add and fill form fields.
  • Scan to PDF — Your camera. Your document.
  • Repair PDF — Recover readable pages.
  • Unlock PDF — Open with your password.
  • Protect PDF — Password-protect a document.
  • PDF to PDF/A — Create a PDF/A-2b archival copy.
  • Summarize PDF — Find the key sentences.
  • Translate PDF — Translate English ↔ Hindi locally.
